business_problem: Always seeking innovation, it aimed to enhance its knowledge management platform to provide more efficient content creation and advanced AI capabilities for its global clientele across various industries.
solution_summary: KMS Lighthouse used Azure OpenAI Service, Dynamics 365 Field Service, Power Platform to replace disconnected manual workflows with a more consistent digital operating model. Customer and service data that had been scattered across CRM, service, and support tools were consolidated into Dynamics 365 so sales, case handling, dispatch, and reporting could run on a single omnichannel platform. Low-code automation and copilot capabilities orchestrate tasks, route work, and surface context to agents or business users without requiring separate point solutions. Where generative AI is involved, Azure OpenAI handles the language understanding layer while connected data and workflow services keep responses grounded in enterprise context. It also connects with surrounding systems such as Call-center telephony, which lets the new Azure-based workflow fit into existing operations rather than standing apart from them. KMS Lighthouse helps companies retrieve and share enterprise.

solution_components.name: Azure OpenAI Service
solution_components.role: Runs large language model inference for summarization, extraction, conversational AI, and grounded answers.

solution_components.name: Dynamics 365 Field Service
solution_components.role: Coordinates work orders, field dispatch, and downstream service execution.

solution_components.name: Power Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the low-code automation and application platform for workflow modernization.

solution_components.name: Azure Marketplace
solution_components.role: Distributes the solution through Microsoft’s commercial marketplace channel.

data_flow: Content and operational context are prepared in the application data layer, passed to Azure OpenAI for generation or extraction, stored in Azure storage services, and returned through the user-facing application to employees or customers with grounded responses.
